name: Monsters
source:
You play as Silas, a troubled vampire haunted by nightmares of his past. When a strange new kid arrives at his hospital and refuses to leave him alone, Silas’s fragile sanity begins to crack. Soon, he’s certain the newcomer is a monster – and there’s only room for one.

[From [url=https://itsreylagirlarts.itch.io/monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演塞拉斯，一个陷入困境的吸血鬼，被过去的噩梦所困扰。当一个陌生的新孩子来到他的医院并拒绝让他独自一人时，塞拉斯脆弱的理智开始崩溃。很快，他确信这个新来者是一个怪物——而且这里只容得下一个怪物。

[来自[url=https://itsreylagirlarts.itch.io/monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
